text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing.
Yielding to Vivlos's begging,
we took a detour to the arcade.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainie, look, look!
I got it~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right?♪
Aren't I amazing!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...'It's Petit Vi-chan!
Trainy, let's take purikura next time♪'"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"With mini-me and regular-me,
we're hitting Trainer with a double cute attack, mwah!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Did it work?
That was like two of the usual me!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?

"...And so, granting Double Vivlos's wish,
we arrived in front of the photo sticker booth."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeny, meeny, miny, moe! Which one should I pick!
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Decided, this way!

A sudden weight bore down on my arm, shifting my center of gravity.
Before I knew it, Verxina had clung tightly around my arm.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aha♡
The inside is super cute too♪
choice_data_list: Vivlos!? What was that linked arm just now...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hm? If we're going out, you're coming with, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, let's make a heart shape!
I make them with my big sister all the time♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Put your right hand against my left hand, okay?♡

Between linking arms earlier and everything else, Viqbross gets way too close.
I need to maintain proper boundaries...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Petite Viv-chan wants to do that too!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Is that a no?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehe.
Thanks, Trainie♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Alright, next up is...

text_block_list.name: Ice Cream Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Releasing simultaneously!
Pistachio Cream Hachimi Latte and
Yuzu Apple Hachimi Smoothie~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, both look so good...!
But they're both pretty big...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Train-chi!
This time, let's split the drink in half—
choice_data_list: No, no, no! That's going a bit too far!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Is that a no?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
choice_data_list: Even if Petit-Viblos asks, it's still a no.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...If I could drink both of those,
I feel like I'd do super well in my next race, though.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Look, Petite-Vib is saying it too.
"Please♡ I wanna drink it♡"
choice_data_list: Petit-Viblos can't drink that, you know.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Look, Petite-Vib is saying it too.
"Please♡ I wanna drink it♡"
choice_data_list: Petit-Viblos can't drink that, you know.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ? A proposal?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My, are you sure?
Even for a passerby like me...

The desperate measure was to somehow find
a friend of Vivlos nearby and have them share it with her.
choice_data_list: Yeah, split half of it with Vivlos.
Yeah, share it half-and-half with Vivlos, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Satono!
Can I have a little bit of that over there?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes♪
Please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eheheh. ......

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you gonna buy one for yourself, Trainie?
I kinda wanted a bite of yours too~
choice_data_list: N-No way! No sharing, not even a single bite!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Whoa. Harsh.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"You're being too strict, Trainy!"
Jeez!

And Viwbros kept lightly punching me
with Puchi Viw-chan's tiny hands...
